image-compressor: JPG and WebP compression is normally lossy; PNG results depend on the encoder and settings. A smaller file can show artifacts, and an already optimized file may not shrink. Compare the downloaded image at its intended display size.
image-resizer: Upscaling cannot recover detail that is absent from the source. Resizing changes pixel dimensions and may affect sharpness; supported input formats depend on browser decoding support.
jpg-to-png: JPEG has no alpha channel. Converting to PNG preserves the visible pixels supported by the browser decoder but cannot recover or intelligently invent transparency.
png-to-jpg: JPEG does not support transparency. Transparent regions are flattened during conversion, so review the background and visible quality before replacing the PNG.
image-to-webp: WebP supports lossy and lossless encoding, but conversion settings determine the result. Check transparency, color, fine text and browser/platform compatibility rather than assuming a fixed percentage saving.
image-to-url: A blob URL is local to the current browser context and is not a public hosting or sharing URL. A data URL embeds the image data in the URL string; it can be copied where data URLs are accepted but may be blocked or unwieldy.
pdf-merger: Encrypted, damaged or unusual PDFs may not parse. Review page order, dimensions, forms, annotations and links in the downloaded output; merging does not guarantee that every interactive feature survives.
pdf-compressor: Compression cannot guarantee a target size or unchanged visual quality. Already optimized PDFs may shrink little, and aggressive image recompression can blur scans, small text, signatures or QR codes.
pdf-counter: The count is available when the browser-side PDF library can parse the document. Encrypted, corrupted or nonstandard files can fail; a successful count is not a full document validation.
pdf-lock: Password protection is only as useful as the password and receiving viewer's standards support. There is no recovery service for a forgotten password. Test the downloaded file in the recipient's PDF viewer.
passport-photo-maker: The only current preset center-crops to a 600×600 JPEG for 2×2 inches at 300 DPI. It does not support every country's dimensions or certify acceptance. Verify recency, pose, lighting, background, head proportions and alteration rules with the issuing authority.
short-link: This utility creates a readable display label for the full destination; it does not create a short redirect or call a third-party service. Anyone using the link still visits the original URL.
og-previewer: The entered URL is sent to our server and fetched from the destination. Private networks, oversized responses and excessive redirects are blocked, but bot protection and network errors can still prevent fetching. A preview is approximate; verify the live share with each platform's debugger.
llm-token-counter: Token counts and prices are estimates unless computed with the exact model tokenizer and current provider pricing. Context overhead, multimodal input and provider-specific accounting can change the billed amount.
jwt-decoder: Decoding a JWT does not verify its signature, issuer, audience, expiry or authorization. Payloads are readable, not encrypted; use short-lived test tokens and revoke exposed credentials.
invoice-generator: Generated documents are drafting aids, not tax, legal or accounting advice. Confirm invoice numbering, tax treatment, currency, required fields and retention rules for the relevant jurisdiction.
big-five-personality-test: This is an educational self-report exercise, not a psychological assessment, diagnosis or hiring decision tool. Results depend on the questions and scoring implemented and should not be treated as clinical advice.
enneagram-personality-test: This is an educational self-report exercise, not a validated clinical diagnosis. Do not use the result for medical, employment or other high-impact decisions.
keyword-density: Counts describe the supplied text under the tool's tokenization rules. There is no recommended density that guarantees rankings; prioritize clear, original content and real search intent.
llms-txt-generator: An llms.txt file is a convention, not a guarantee that models or crawlers will read, obey or cite it. Keep canonical robots.txt, metadata, sitemaps and public permissions aligned with the policy you actually want.
ai-crawler-robots-generator: Crawler directives only affect agents that choose to honor them, and user-agent support changes. Verify current crawler documentation and do not describe generated rules as access control or legal protection.
text-to-speech: Voices, languages and speech behavior depend on the browser and operating system. Audio export is available only where the implementation explicitly supports it; a voice preview is not a generated audio file.
meta-title-checker: Length guidance is approximate. Search engines can truncate or rewrite titles and descriptions, so a passing length check does not guarantee the displayed snippet or rankings.
